build_SocialNavReward: build a reward measure that gives continuous social navigation rewards with safe distance, facing, and exploration components
build_SocialNavStats: build a stats measure that tracks human detection, distance metrics, backup yield counts, and SPL for social navigation
build_SocialNavSeekSuccess: build a success measure that evaluates if the robot follows the human within safe distance and facing thresholds
build_HumanoidDetectorSensor: build a sensor that detects humans in panoptic segmentation images and returns binary masks or bounding boxes
build_InitialGpsCompassSensor: build a sensor that returns polar coordinates of the robot relative to its initial starting position
